title: Empowering Consumers in Green Transition - E2E Product Spec

1_1_compliance.user_story: As an EU buyer, I see a verified Eco-Label badge backed by accredited certification data on the View Item page.
acceptance_criteria: Display EU Eco-Label badge when seller uploads valid certificate URN
Tooltip links to EU Eco-Label registry verifier
Render badge in compliance with EU UI visual identity guidelines

1_1_compliance.user_story: As a seller, my listing form scans for prohibited greenwashing keywords and blocks unverified 'carbon neutral' claims.
acceptance_criteria: Listing API flags prohibited phrases ('100% climate neutral', 'zero emission product')
Validation banner directs seller to attach accredited verification certificate

1_1_compliance.user_story: As a buyer, I see harmonised commercial guarantee duration and repairability index score badges.
acceptance_criteria: Guarantee notice rendered with EU harmonised icon
Repairability score rendered on 1.0 - 10.0 scale visual badge

1_1_compliance.user_story: As an EU buyer purchasing smart electronics, I see the minimum guaranteed software update support period.
acceptance_criteria: Item Specifics renders 'Software Support End Date' or 'Guaranteed Updates (Years)'
Mandatory field for B2C sellers in Consumer Electronics category

1_2_enhancements.user_story: As an EU buyer, I can filter search results by Repairability Index score (e.g. >= 7.0).
acceptance_criteria: Search SRP filter sidebar includes Repairability Index range slider

2_deferred.user_story: Automated Document AI parsing of seller-uploaded eco-certificates.
acceptance_criteria: OCR extracts certificate expiration and issuer automatically
